propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple orthogonal lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, ID re-keying, comment identity, tombstones, retirement) that should be extracted into a cohesive private policy owner

Production code mutates internal binding dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() copy, bypassing mutation policy enforcement; a narrow facade operation (note_rich_emit) must become the supported mutation seam
Lifecycle operations must preserve at-most-one identity via targeted reverse-key pops in only existing permitted cases without detecting or refusing ambiguous double binds
Comment IDs are append-only/change-gated, numeric-ID lookups re-key rather than retire, three confirmed 404s trigger retirement, and legacy entries without ID fields remain readable without rewrite
The public BindingStore facade must retain all existing method signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics with no caller obtaining direct repository mutation access
